name: Persicaria

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. You're as dedicated to your work as ever.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Would you like a cup of coffee first? It should put some pep in your step. Don't worry, I'll go light on the sugar.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Are you done with your dinner already? It's okay to take it slow from time to time.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's common for scientists to work late into the night, but I think you could use some rest now.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Dr. Persica is not here with us, but nevertheless, I must fulfill my duty.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Which do you think goes best with coffee: sugar cubes, granulated sugar, or syrup? Hmm... I'm actually fine with any of them.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, you look so peaceful whenever you're asleep. Those dark circles under your eyes are awfully pronounced, though.

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: It's nice to get some fresh air every once in a while. Ms. Antonina, are you coming with me?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: As always, I'll be patrolling and maintaining the Oasis. Shall we do it together?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Anything I can help you with?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Perhaps we should focus on the tasks at hand during work hours?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: I kindly ask you to be mindful of basic etiquette. Otherwise, I'll have to make a report to Dr. Persica.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Let me handle these duties.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: It's me, Persicaria. It's been a while... We can discuss the details later. Let me become your most reliable assistant in this unknown world.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I can feel inspiration welling up within me.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Although there is no end to the pursuit of science, I've taken another small step forward.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: As my knowledge and power grow, so should my willpower and soul. It's time for me to face my responsibilities. Persicaria... I will not let anyone down, ever.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Scanner debugging complete.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Enemy detected ahead.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Target locked on, neural network amplification initiated!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I am glad everyone is fine.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Battle finished.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Sorry... Dr. Persica...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Even if you had not said anything today, I would have always supported you regardless. We are comrades who share the same sentiment, and you are a person worthy of my trust and respect. But from today onwards, our relationship might become a little bit different...

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year. I'd like to make the Oasis look more festive, but that would be a lot of work... Oh? Are you going to help me?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Here, this is chocolate with hazelnut and raspberry jam filling... Erm, I hope you don't mind the shape... A-anyway, please accept it as a small token of my appreciation.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I've prepared a watermelon for this special occasion. Before we dive in, how about we draw something on the outside of it?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Professor, I can't believe you didn't prepare anything for Halloween... Well, I can help you come up with something. I've been collecting this candy for a while now, and we can hand it out to the kids. You can have some too.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I got this raspberry chocolate cake recipe from a book. I went and changed the proportion of syrup to cream to make the texture smoother. If it's too sweet for you, here's a cup of black coffee with sugar cubes. Merry Christmas, by the way!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Isn't today your birthday, Professor? As your loyal assistant, I've prepared you a... special gift for today. It's not expensive, but I really put a lot of thought into it. Please take it.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: I've always wanted to have a proper chat with you, but my work never seems to end... Can we talk another time when we are both free? I'll be happy to make you a cup of coffee.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Sorry, I'm a little late.
How do you like your coffee? Uh... Was it too sweet? But sugar can help reinvigorate you. That's why Dr. Persica and I always put so much sugar in our coffee.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I realize you're the one who started this conversation... But I have a question I'd like to ask you as well.
I wonder, what do you think of Dr. Persica? And what do you think of... me?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Do you think I'm capable of shouldering more important responsibilities? I may have tried to avoid my responsibilities in the past... But now, I see things differently. Would you be willing to listen to me?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
How does your coffee taste today? I didn't add any sugar cubes. Of course, if you like it sweet, you can add some more sugar to your liking. Then again, perhaps a cup of bitter coffee is good once in a while.
Anyway, thank you very much for listening to me today. Let's continue looking out for each other.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mhm~

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: I see.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Eh...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

career:
The Persicaria Type Doll, or namely "Persicaria", is a privately owned research Doll, developed by Dr. Persica, founder of the 16Lab research institute under 42Lab. Modeled after her developer, Persicaria focuses on the research of artificial intelligence. In this field, she is both the researcher and the research subject.

The unique relationship between Dolls and AIs makes it very likely for Dolls researching this topic to experience physical and mental speculative dysfunctions. To solve this issue, Persicaria is equipped with a unique data buffer. When a logical contradiction is detected in her Neural Cloud System, the affected part will be quarantined for logic reconfiguration to be performed in the back-end, while providing redundant data for temporary front-end system operations.

After 42Lab launched Project Neural Cloud, Dr. Persica sent her to participate in the experiment in 42Lab for reasons unknown.
infoStories:
[Authorized View]

According to a certain 42Lab researcher, his first encounter with Persicaria happened naturally. On the morning of █/█, █, he pushed open the door to Dr. Persica's office, ready to salvage the documents he needed from a messy pile leftover from an all-nighter; but Persicaria, whose appearance was almost exactly the same as her creator, had already sorted out everything. Smiling, she handed him the research documents he was looking for.

After that, Persicaria quickly took over a part of her creator's work. Thanks to her remarkable performance, Dr. Persica granted her the same authority as human researchers, allowing her to participate in many important scientific research projects of various research organizations as an independent Doll researcher.

As for questions like how she created Persicaria's human form, what kind of technology was applied, and why did she do so, Dr. Persica simply prevaricated by saying, "I did it on a whim during my spare time". This explanation was somehow convincing, considering how she has always been a maverick. On top of that, since her efficiency has been excellent, the researchers gradually warmed up to her as a special colleague.

[Authorized View]

Even among the researchers of 42Lab, Persicaria was the best of the best. She seemed to be uniquely gifted in the field of artificial intelligence. Her performance always exceeded everyone's expectations, be it during project conception or problem-solving. During the first two years after her appearance, Persicaria provided several crucial research ideas and detailed implementation plans for the five projects she had participated in, making breakthroughs in three different research fields. At the same time, Persicaria led optimization research on the Doll data buffer system with herself as the experimental subject, which laid an important theoretical foundation for the research and development of a new generation of Dolls.

Playing key roles in multiple important projects earned Persicaria recognition inside the research institute. However, few people were aware that she had sacrificed her rest, and even mealtime, for those accomplishments. Different from the conventional Dolls, Persicaria was built with a large portion of bionic modular components instead of mechanical parts. Therefore, rest and food were particularly important to Persicaria when most Dolls found them unnecessary. However, she still put work before her personal needs and never gave herself a single day off.

No matter how many all-nighters she had pulled in a row before, Persicaria always seemed organized and energetic when she interacted with colleagues. The increasingly sweetened and concentrated coffee by her hand was the only trace of her overwork.

[Authorized View]

Persicaria seldom talks about herself. She tends to hide away and leave the spotlight to others when the time comes for commendations. Perhaps this is partly for her own protection—thanks to having kept a low profile, little proof of Persicaria's existence can be found on public sources; on the other hand, according to an orange-haired female Doll who wishes to remain anonymous, perhaps it also stems from her doubt about her own abilities.

"Persicaria always hides her emotions well, and works day and night to conceal her insecurities... Ever since I met her, she's been pushing herself constantly because she feared she could not live up to everyone's expectations. Now she's even more so..."

"Perhaps it started from the 'Silver Fire Incident'... Since then, she has been very self-conscious. After participating in Project Neural Cloud, we all thought ██████, █████████. ███████, ███████, ███████. If only I was more... Huh, that's really unlike me to say."

"Perhaps the Professor will have a way to help her let go of her fears... but the decision is Persicaria's to make, not ours. The least we can do is share her burden as much as we can."
—Documented footage of a meeting between Dolls

[Authorized View]

The name "Persicaria" was listed among the many developers at the time of the announcement of Project Neural Cloud. Persicaria was involved in the project as both a test subject and a developer, and she was in contact with many of the subject Dolls early on during the recruitment process.

Thus, several years after the "Wipe-off Incident" when the Dolls awoke from their neural cocoons, Persicaria naturally assumed the role of leader of the "Exiles" until the arrival of the Professor.

From the difficult explorations and team-building at the beginning, to the construction of the Oasis and the rescuing of stranded Dolls, Persicaria has put in an unimaginable amount of effort. Most Dolls remember her to be always busy working with a gentle smile on her face. Only a selected few know what she hides under that smile.

"Don't worry, I won't collapse. Rather, I cannot afford to collapse here. I can't lose anyone again. To protect everyone, even if I...!"

"Sorry, I seem to have lost my temper... Thank you for your concern. I have to go check the firewall monitoring data of the Oasis next, so I may have to excuse myself for a while. You should be quite busy lately too, right? Please make sure to take some rest. If you need anything, be sure to let me know. I will make some time for that... Yes. I will see you in the afternoon during the routine medical department inspection."
—In front of Persicaria's office - A Security System Recording

[Authorized View]

███████████████████. ███, █████████, █████████.███████, ███████, ███████████, █████████, █████████.

"Professor, I have set you to be the only person authorized to view this file. I am glad that you are reading this. Perhaps you are simply curious; perhaps you are concerned about me; or perhaps you are seeking an answer... but I have to tell you that not even I know the full picture of the truth. "

"I must apologize for having redacted parts of this file. I did it not out of mistrust. I believe most Dolls here understand that regardless of your identity and true purpose, you are a person to be trusted and relied on. I am no different from them. It's just the time has not yet come to reveal those to you. Perhaps sometime in the future I will tell you everything, and until then, we still have more important issues to settle... The only thing I can promise is that no matter what happens, I will be on your side. Please trust me."

"And, although I have never said it before..."

"You are an irreplaceable leader for the Exiles, and for me, too... Well, I just wanted to say..."

"Thank you, truly."
—A short audio recording
oathDesc: You are as essential as her coffee mug—always by her side, and keeping her warm and awake on late nights.

projections.name: Special AI Researcher
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"The taste of coffee, though bitter, will be remembered."

projections.name: Special AI Researcher
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"The taste of coffee, though bitter, will be remembered."

projections.name: Walking with You
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"In your footsteps I will witness our resolute journey filled with hope, together with the Oasis and the Exiles."

skinList.name: Afternoon Nap
skinList.desc:
A slightly cold latte, a stack of to-do lists, and the unfinished dream of an Exile.
"Hmm... Can't rest yet... for the sake of the Oasis... Professor... zzzZ..."

skinList.name: Peaceful Gift
skinList.desc:
[Christmas Eve Invitation Series]
 Wearing a festive-themed outfit lends a sense of ceremony to tonight's encounter.
"Thank you for all the hard work you put in while giving out those gifts, Professor. Would you like to take a short break before we continue?"
So says the girl as she sneaks a carefully-wrapped present into the sack.

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"Coffee might taste bitter, but adding 10 cubes of sugar makes it palatable."

skinList.name: Mocha Chorus
skinList.desc:
"Otium" Series — Doing as the heart desires, abandoning convention. Doing away with strict and orderly uniform, returning to one's true self in brief moments of respite.
"Overtime? Today's a holiday, you know. Even coffee will taste different in times of rest. Want a cup of mocha, Professor?"

skinList.name: Besotted Evernight
skinList.desc:
"Splendid Evening" Series — Warm breath, intertwined with afloat aromas, lingering atop one's cup, mellowed through the young night.
"I can see that shocked look on your face in the goblet... Then, shall we confide in each other here? Or would you... partake in a little something with me?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Right now... Could you please look only at me, just for a while?"

skinList.name: Sweetheart In The Light
skinList.desc:
After accepting her sincere invitation, you spend an unforgettable summer day at the fairground together. Both your heart and hers will always race as you recall your time together.
"Want to ride with me, Professor? Mounted on white horses, whirling amidst the lights... and always by your side, forever and ever."

skinList.name: Inebriating Brownie
skinList.desc:
Revel in a rare moment of relaxation on a sunny, lazy afternoon. As you open the door, the sugary scent of leisure hits you.
The soul's heartbeat rings out with every moment you spend next to Persicaria. The hot vapor emanating from the cup in her hand somewhat obscures your vision as her smile seems to grow ever sweeter.
